{{dablink|For other uses of the word "water," see [[Water (disambiguation)|Water]].}}
The '''water vase''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]].

==Appearance==
The vase is tall and decorated with blue and green vines.

==Use==
The vase can be used to collect water out of the air, a useful thing in dry places. It is unknown whether or not channeling is necessary to make the vase work.{{ref/book|11|15}}
